svg.text: SEN55, SCD41, NX48 display -> WAGO 221-415 clamps (5V / GND / SDA / SCL) -> USB-C supply and Raspberry Pi

g.text: NX48 TX (blue) -> Pi pin 10 RXD0 (direct, no clamp)
NX48 RX (yellow) -> Pi pin 8 TXD0 (direct, no clamp)
SEN55 SEL (black) -> Pi pin 14 GND (direct, selects I²C mode)
• Pi 5V pins (2/4) stay unconnected: sensors and display get
5 V from the USB-C supply through the 5V clamp.
• GND clamp joins supply GND and Pi GND (pin 9). A common
ground is required for I²C and UART.
• SEN55 SEL on GND = I²C mode (as in the code comments).
• I²C bus 1: SEN55 0x69, SCD41 0x62; pull-ups are on the Pi.
• UART is crossed: NX48 TX -> Pi RXD, NX48 RX -> Pi TXD
• Wire colours follow your pictures. Supply leads (red/black)
and Pi leads (SDA blue, SCL yellow) are my assumptions.
